# Agent Instructions

Provides RocKIT agent instruction templates and managed agent documentation for
the Electron Theia application.

The package keeps the human-edited source documents in `AGENTS.template.md` and
`agent-docs/`. The build scripts generate bundled TypeScript modules from those
documents so the application can install and refresh agent guidance from inside
the extension.

## Generated Files

The following files are generated by package scripts and should not be edited
directly:

- `src/electron-browser/agents-template.ts`
- `src/electron-browser/agent-docs-bundle.ts`

Regenerate them with:

```bash
yarn build
```

or:

```bash
yarn compile
```

## Development

```bash
yarn build
yarn test
```
